questions.markdown:
A rectangular pulse is defined as

$$
x(t)=\begin{cases}
A, & 0<t<T\\
0, & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

$x(t)$ is applied to an integrator defined by

$$
y(t)=\int_0^t x(\tau)\,d\tau .
$$

Find the total energy of the signal $y(2t)$.

Given

$$
x(t)=\begin{cases}
5-t, & 4\leq t\leq 5\\
1, & -4\leq t\leq 4\\
t+5, & -5\leq t\leq -4\\
0, & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

Plot the signal.

Also plot $x(10t-5)$.

The impulse response of RC filter is given by $h(t)=e^{-t}u(t)$. Using convolution, determine its output for the input

i) $x(t)=e^{-|t|}$

ii) $x(t)$ is unity height pulse extending from $t=-1$ to $t=1$

Determine and sketch the output for a system defined by impulse response

$$
h(n)=(0.25)\{u[n]-u[n-5]\}
$$

if the input is

$$
x[n]=u[n]-u[n-10].
$$

Sketch the block diagram representation for the following systems. The realization should be using minimum number of delay units or integrators.

i)

$$
y[n]+2y[n-2]-3y[n-3]=x[n-1]+5x[n-2]
$$

ii)

$$
\frac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)-2\frac{d}{dt}y(t)+3y(t)=\frac{d}{dt}x(t)+x(t)
$$

Determine convolution of the signals using Fourier representation

$$
x_1[n]=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n u[n]
$$

$$
x_2[n]=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^n u[n]
$$

questions.markdown:
Determine the DTFS coefficient of the following signal using method of inspection

$$
x[n]=\cos\left(\frac{\pi n}{4}+\varphi\right)
$$

Determine the Fourier Transforms of the following signal using tables of transforms and properties

$$
x(t)=\frac{d}{dt}\,e^{-2t}u(t)
$$

Determine frequency response and impulse response of the system described by the following differential equation using Fourier representation

$$
\frac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)+5\frac{d}{dt}y(t)+6y(t)=-\frac{d}{dt}x(t)
$$

Consider the system depicted in the Fig 4B.2 and let the Fourier transform of the input signal $x(t)$ is depicted in Fig 4B.1. Sketch $Z(j\omega)$ and $Y(j\omega)$ for $w(t)=\cos(3\pi t)$ and $h(t)=\dfrac{\sin(6\pi t)}{\pi t}$.

questions.markdown:
Consider the sinusoidal signal

$$
x(t)=3\cos(3000\pi t)
$$

and the sampling frequency is $2\,\text{KHz}$.

a) Determine the expression of the sampled sequence and plot it.

b) Plot the fourier transform of the sampled sequence.

For the system

$$
H(z)=\frac{1-0.8z^{-1}+16z^{-2}}{1-\frac{1}{2}z^{-1}+\frac{1}{4}z^{-2}}
$$

identify the transfer function of the inverse system, and determine whether the inverse system can be both causal and stable

Determine the impulse response of the system characterized by

$$
y(n)=2.5y(n-1)-y(n-2)+x(n)-5x(n-1)+6x(n-2)
$$

using $z$-transform
